full_judgment: 3. Defendant No. 1 Uttara Bank obtained the Rule against aforesaid decree of reversal. Opposite party No. 1, Syed Abidur Reza as plaintiff on 17-3-82 instituted Title Suit No. 97 of 1982 against the petitioner and others for a decree of declaration that termination of his service in the bank by defendant No. 2 by letter dated 19-9-81 dispatched vide memo No. 3392A was illegal, malafide, void, without jurisdiction and not binding upon him and that the plaintiff was still in service. The suit was then renumbered as Title Suit No. 110 of 1986 in the aforesaid Court of Munsif at Sylhet.
